_comment: Four glyphs in one font, so a rank is a change of character rather than
a change of font. The code points sit in the private use area, which is
the range set aside for exactly this - nothing else will ever claim them.
E000 standard, E001 developer, E002 owner, E003 vip.
height 8 matches a line of name tag text. ascent 7 drops the glyph one
pixel below the text baseline, which is what lines the middle of the
planet up with the middle of the letters instead of its top edge.
